A reminder to protect the wild. With only a few thousand left, every moment with them is a blessing. 🌍🧡

Linkin Park wasn’t just a band — they were a *gateway*.
The first time those distorted synths slammed into rap verses and raw emotion, something rewired in my brain.

They made techno feel angry, rap feel vulnerable, and rock feel futuristic.
Before playlists, before algorithms — LP taught a whole generation how genres could *collide* and still make sense.

For millennials, this wasn’t background music.
This was headphones on, volume maxed, feeling-seen-at-2AM music.
From **Hybrid Theory** to **Meteora**, they walked so today’s electronic, rap, and alt scenes could run.

If you ever screamed the chorus, nodded through the verses, or got pulled into techno and rap because of them — you know.
Linkin Park forever shaped the sound of our chaos. 🖤❤️🥰

Thayambaka - Thayambaka is a ritual temple art that is often performed at annual festivals, but it can also be performed outside of temples at proscenium stages, open fields, or pageantry grounds. 
The structure of a thayambaka recital is thought to have developed from a combination of the classical Carnatic music of Tamil Nadu and the percussion tradition of central Kerala. 
The main instrument in a thayambaka is the chenda, a drum made from the soft wood of the jackfruit tree. The chenda is often used to accompany other forms of dance and rituals in Kerala, such as Kathakali, Koodiyattam, and Kannyar Kali.

latestIgtvVideos.title: A Valentines Day Challenge
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
Happy Valentines Day! We have a challenge for you. It’s all explained in the video above, or you can just keep reading below!

If you decide to participate, tag us in your post or story so we can repost our favorites and spread the love :) Bringing Kara coffee in bed every morning guarantees that no matter what happens the rest of the day, I have at least done one nice thing for her! It’s one of the best things I do for our relationship, and we love it when other people tag us bringing their partner coffee too, because we want this little habit to become a part of as many relationships as possible! 
So, on this Valentines day, we’re issuing you an official challenge to bring your partner coffee (or their drink of choice) in bed everyday for the rest of the month!

If for some reason your circumstances don’t allow you to bring your loved one coffee in bed, your challenge is to come up with some way you can add one thoughtful thing into your daily routine.

That’s it. There’s no prize or anything for completing the challenge. I just wanted to spread the idea of intentionally doing something thoughtful for your partner everyday.

latestPosts.caption:
January 2020 🖤 This night will forever feel like a dream to me. I always describe it as the best night of my life. The people we met that night left a permanent imprint on my heart. I think about this night ALL the time. 

We spent 4 years traveling to 100 countries. After we reached our goal, we found ourselves here in Nashville with a million YouTube subscribers.

But when we first left home, it was 0.

Those 4 years were such a whirlwind. So by the time we landed back in Tennessee at this party, I don’t think we had even processed all we had gone through. (Which is why I cried happy tears all night 🙃)

We got to celebrate with over 700 of our biggest cheerleaders. And it was the first time I physically got to experience just how much love we are surrounded by. It was surreal. 

After this night, we had ZERO plan for what was next with our lives.

Turns out…it was a pandemic. But this night, we had no idea that was coming. Then right after, everything changed. Which is kinda why it feels even more like a dream. 

It’s been 3 whole years since our party 🤯 SO much has changed! But we are more grateful than EVER to be back in action, traveling the world, and still surrounded by so much love!!! The fact that we are still doing this thing is so darn cool. 

If you were at our 100 country party, in case I didn’t get to tell you in real life, thank you, and I love you 🥹🫶🏻 

Also, huge shoutout to @heathandalyssa for basically being the only reason this night actually happened 😁 Y’all are the best. 

PS making goals is so fun because then you get to celebrate when you reach them. What should our next goal be??? I’m ready for another party 🥳💃🏻

Everyone loved my $40 dress from Target, no one noticed that Nate repeated his same outfit from 4 years ago, and we finally got some photos taken of us that aren’t selfies! I’d consider that a win 🏆 

In all seriousness though :) We are so honored to have been nominated and a part of this event, and beyond thankful for the community that got us here! Times like these are a fun opportunity to look back at where we started back in 2016 - broke newlyweds with no idea what we were doing. Never thought this journey would lead us here 7 years later! Even though I still feel like we’re making it up as we go ;) 

Love y’all 🫶🏻❤️

May 5, 2007 ➡️ May 5, 2023! 
It’s our 16 year dating anniversary 🤯🥰 Tried our best to recreate our awk high school prom pose 🤣 One thing that hasn’t changed…apparently we’ve always loved wearing black!

Secret’s out! 🤭🤰🏻Can you believe it????

I spent my entire first trimester on the Mongol Rally 🤣 And I honestly wouldn’t change it. I was 8 weeks along when we arrived in Tbilisi, Georgia, and so we paid $30 to get an ultrasound. They allowed ALL 9 OF US to be in the room together for the most shocking, magical, emotional, beautiful experience of my life! Getting to see an actual baby with a beating heart inside of me for the first time - the little thing that had been making me nauseas, vomit, hormonal, bloated, excited, and terrified all at the same time - was actually REAL. I am in love with this feeling and don’t think I can ever get over it. And getting to share that experience with a room full of people I love so much was a dream I didn’t even know I had. 

Just WOW! Thank you to everyone who watched our announcement video - I can FEEL all of your love and joy to my core! Nate and I are so grateful. This week has been indescribable. Thank you thank you thank you 🥹💛

Mongol Rally days 1 through 10 🚌 Big Bertha has now driven across 8 countries! We’ve been dreaming of this trip since January, and so far it’s lived up to all the hype. 

Failed border crossings (see pic #8😂) sunflower fields, bus raves, bear sightings, waterfalls, swims, mud baths…Loving all the chaos with the fam! 💛 

Scroll to the end to see the stats we’re keeping tally of! 

📍Colorado, USA to: Germany, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, Moldova, & Bulgaria 🫶🏼 

@mongolrallyofficial about 35 days to go!
6 weeks. 7,000 miles. 9 best friends. 15 countries. 1 Big Bertha. 0 idea. @mongolrallyofficial day 1 is officially here!!!!!! 🚌
